nodes.label: HACS zip_release content_in_root Convention
nodes.rationale: HACS's zip_release download mode with content_in_root:false extracts the release archive straight into the plugin's own folder, so the zip's contents must sit at the top level (built from inside public/) rather than under a public/ wrapper directory.

nodes.label: Test workflow (GitHub Actions)
nodes.rationale: No npm, no dependencies: tests load the shipped public/*.js directly.

nodes.label: Verify presentation changes by looking (screenshot/DOM)
nodes.rationale: code can be correct and the pixel wrong or invisible; when an element is missing suspect markup before logic

nodes.label: Literal style= attribute (property:{{ value }})
nodes.rationale: CSS property names are read from the literal attribute at compile time; a hole holding 'width:13px' compiles to an empty style silently

nodes.label: Dynamic src/href/points via ref callback after mount
nodes.rationale: browser parser loads them before JS runs
nodes.norm_label: dynamic src/href/points via ref callback after mount

nodes.label: window.CASA_CONFIG global config
nodes.rationale: import() is blocked under file:// where demo mode runs

nodes.label: panel_custom tag derived from folder (<cartella>-panel)
nodes.rationale: under HACS always live_dashboard-panel; a wrong tag gave a silent black screen

nodes.label: HA energy schema flat for grid (stat_energy_from top level)
nodes.norm_label: ha energy schema flat for grid (stat_energy_from top level)

nodes.label: Never same expression in two sc-if with opposite hint-placeholder-val
nodes.rationale: both branches rendered in the live DOM (v1.8.1 Ultime azioni); expose negation under its own name
nodes.norm_label: never same expression in two sc-if with opposite hint-placeholder-val

nodes.label: Density before one-screen fit (44px targets, 10px text)
nodes.rationale: never compress typography, touch targets or spacing to fit more in the first screen; scroll instead

nodes.label: Retired 1280x800 no-scroll constraint (v1.4.9)
nodes.rationale: with 12 rooms and 4 cameras inner column scroll is normal

nodes.label: Energy role colors (--sage self-consumption, --acc import, --feed export)
nodes.rationale: sage family = sun, terracotta = grid; ring and bars must share the grammar, deviation is a bug

nodes.label: Regenerate graphify-out/ in the same commit
nodes.rationale: graphify-out is the repo map; if stale it describes a version that no longer exists
nodes.norm_label: regenerate graphify-out/ in the same commit

nodes.label: Verify graph coverage by symbol grep, not node count
nodes.rationale: semantic extraction is distributed; node totals (492/571/615/513) vary per run and are not a regression signal
nodes.norm_label: verify graph coverage by symbol grep, not node count

nodes.label: No graphify post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: the hook's AST-only rebuild after commit overwrites the semantic graph with a poorer one (254 vs 298 nodes)

nodes.label: User config in config/www/live_dashboard_config.js
nodes.rationale: outside the HACS-managed folder so updates don't overwrite it

nodes.label: Single VERSION in public/panel.js for cache-busting
nodes.norm_label: single version in public/panel.js for cache-busting

nodes.label: A tag is not a release (push tag + gh release create)
nodes.rationale: HACS shows releases, not tags; a pushed tag without release reaches nobody
nodes.norm_label: a tag is not a release (push tag + gh release create)

nodes.label: Every user-facing diagnostic has a visible Diagnostica counterpart
nodes.rationale: companion app / wall tablet users have no console.log
nodes.norm_label: every user-facing diagnostic has a visible diagnostica counterpart

nodes.label: Live Dashboard — irrigation safety close (automation blueprint)
nodes.rationale: The dashboard's timed close needs at least one open dashboard; this runs inside HA so it covers zero open dashboards, a powered-off tablet, or a hand-opened valve. Set max a bit above the longest dashboard duration (e.g. 5/10/15 -> 20 min). A for: timer doesn't survive restart, hence the start trigger.
nodes.norm_label: live dashboard — irrigation safety close (automation blueprint)

nodes.label: Restart sweep closing still-open switches and valves
nodes.norm_label: restart sweep closing still-open switches and valves

nodes.label: Vendored React 18.3.1 runtime (public/vendor/)
nodes.rationale: support.js downloaded React from unpkg on every load, so an offline HA, a CDN-blocking network or an unpkg outage meant a blank tablet with no message while the README claimed no dependencies. Files are byte-identical to unpkg (SHA-384 matches the SRI pinned in support.js, rechecked by a test); the CDN stays only as fallback if vendor/ is missing.

nodes.label: Vendored Caprasimo and Figtree web fonts (woff2)
nodes.rationale: Removes the Google Fonts dependency; Figtree is variable, so one file per subset covers every weight including 500, which the browser previously synthesized. Verified zero requests leave the installation at startup.
nodes.norm_label: vendored caprasimo and figtree web fonts (woff2)

nodes.label: Differential state push (casa:hass-states-delta)
nodes.rationale: panel.js copied all of hass.states (666 entities, ~175 KB) into the iframe every 600 ms and the dashboard re-rendered even for entities it never shows. HA replaces an entity's object when it changes, so a reference comparison suffices; a no-op update sends nothing. Measured 4 messages / ~14 KB in 30 s. A full snapshot is resent every 5 minutes and on iframe reload as a safety net.

nodes.label: Camera live view actually live (broken since v1.5.4)
nodes.rationale: Tested on a real Imou HEVC 2560x1440 camera: the live view never played more than 0.45 s, played audio loudly, and the still fallback never completed a frame on slow cameras.
nodes.norm_label: camera live view actually live (broken since v1.5.4)

nodes.label: Stable per-stream video ref callback
nodes.rationale: A new ref callback on every render (the countdown re-renders once a second) reset src and restarted the stream: 14 reloads in 10 s. Each stream now has a stable callback that touches nothing unless the stream changes.

nodes.label: Real muting of the camera video element
nodes.rationale: React did not apply the template's muted attribute, so camera audio played at high volume from the wall tablet; the video is now muted for real.
nodes.norm_label: real muting of the camera video element

nodes.label: Load-chained fast still frames for slow cameras
nodes.rationale: The still URL changed every 400 ms and on every render, cancelling every load on cameras needing 8.5 s per still. The next frame is now requested only after the previous one arrived, loaded off-screen then swapped in: first image after 2 s, then one every 2-3 s.
nodes.norm_label: load-chained fast still frames for slow cameras

nodes.label: Idempotent _bindAttr (no rewrite of an unchanged attribute)
nodes.rationale: Rewriting an attribute with the same value restarted the load of any ; _bindAttr now skips identical values.
nodes.norm_label: idempotent _bindattr (no rewrite of an unchanged attribute)

nodes.label: Camera live layer order: hls.js, then native HLS, then stills
nodes.rationale: hls.js is used wherever Media Source exists; native HLS only where hls.js cannot run (iOS before 17.1). Chrome answers 'maybe' to canPlayType for HLS but its native player is the least predictable; this matches Home Assistant's own frontend.
nodes.norm_label: camera live layer order: hls.js, then native hls, then stills

nodes.label: Automatic camera layer fallback on runtime error
nodes.rationale: A layer failing while playing (fatal hls.js error, <video> error) now drops to the next layer instead of leaving a black tile labelled 'Live'; Diagnostica -> Telecamere reports which layer it fell back from and why.
nodes.norm_label: automatic camera layer fallback on runtime error

nodes.label: 'Connecting…' live badge until frames play
nodes.rationale: Home Assistant can take 10-15 s to start a stream, so the badge says 'Connecting…' and only switches to 'Live' once video actually plays.

nodes.label: Alarm PIN pad
nodes.rationale: Panels declaring code_format previously only showed 'use the Home Assistant app'. Numeric codes get a 64 px keypad, alphanumeric codes a password field; the pad stays open until HA answers and clears on a wrong code. The code is never stored, logged in Recent actions, or included in Copy diagnostics. Demo scenario ?demo&scenario=alarm-pin (code 1234).

nodes.label: Irrigation safety close automation blueprint
nodes.rationale: Closes valves left open past a maximum time (20 min default), whoever opened them, plus valves still open at HA restart; covers the v1.8.1 limit that the timed close does not run with zero dashboards open. Handles switch.* and valve.*; validated with validate_config on a real install.

nodes.label: Vendored hls.js 1.7.4 (hls.light.min.js)
nodes.rationale: Loaded only when a camera live view opens, on every browser with Media Source. Before, that live layer was written but always inactive. The v1.5.4 open question assumed it would be the first third-party runtime dependency, but React already was (from CDN); with vendor/ and the integrity test the decision became simple. File identical to the npm package (registry sha512 verified).

nodes.label: Diagnostica -> Ambiente -> 'Runtime React' row
nodes.rationale: Shows whether React came bundled with the dashboard or from unpkg because vendor/ is missing, so wall-tablet users without a console can see the offline guarantee holds.

nodes.label: Dependency-free Node test suite and CI workflow
nodes.rationale: 20 tests via node --test covering section order, visibility, smart plugs, Matter duplicates, discoverRooms discard reasons, vendor integrity, no external resources, i18n key parity and VERSION matching CHANGELOG; .github/workflows/test.yml on push and PR.
nodes.norm_label: dependency-free node test suite and ci workflow

nodes.label: public/vendor/README.md manifest (version, license, hash per file)
nodes.norm_label: public/vendor/readme.md manifest (version, license, hash per file)

nodes.label: call() as single choke point for service calls
nodes.rationale: A support issue (irrigation buttons and climate row 'don't respond', no console errors) showed nothing ever read the outcome of tap -> service call. call() now records ok/error/timeout and duration, toasts on error/timeout but not on success (visible from state change), and never rejects so it stays safe without await.
nodes.norm_label: call() as single choke point for service calls

nodes.label: Diagnostica -> Ultime azioni (Recent actions) ring buffer
nodes.rationale: Session ring buffer of the last 20 calls; the section to paste into future issues.
nodes.norm_label: diagnostica -> ultime azioni (recent actions) ring buffer

nodes.label: Timeout recognized by .code = 'timeout'
nodes.rationale: The 15 s timeout in ha-backend-panel.js is marked with a code instead of an Italian string to compare by hand.

nodes.label: Irrigation state read from the valve entity
nodes.rationale: Valve on -> 'Running · N min' + Stop; only for valve zones, since buttons zones (input_button) give the dashboard no way to know when a run ends.
nodes.norm_label: irrigation state read from the valve entity

nodes.label: Timed irrigation close deadline persisted to frontend/user_data
nodes.rationale: Close no longer depends on a setTimeout in the tab that started it: the deadline is saved (localStorage in demo) and checked every 15 s by any open client, so reloads or switching devices do not leave a valve open. Not sufficient with zero dashboards open.
nodes.norm_label: timed irrigation close deadline persisted to frontend/user_data

nodes.label: Irrigation duration buttons stay pressed until outcome
nodes.rationale: Prevents a second tap before the first one has an outcome.
nodes.norm_label: irrigation duration buttons stay pressed until outcome

nodes.label: Hourly ring history strip (24 stacked bars)
nodes.rationale: Same grammar as the ring but linear: sage self-consumption, terracotta import, light sage export. Data from recorder/statistics_during_period (hour) on the existing statistic_ids, one call per view open, reloaded on the hour. Absent statistics leave the card unchanged and the reason appears in Diagnostica -> Anello energia -> Striscia oraria.
nodes.norm_label: hourly ring history strip (24 stacked bars)

nodes.label: Real cover position band on the cover card
nodes.rationale: A striped terracotta band descends for the closed fraction; read-only, no extra interactive surface, same 44x44 px targets. No band without current_position (never a fake position); follows the slider's optimistic value while dragging.
nodes.norm_label: real cover position band on the cover card

nodes.label: discoverRooms discard-reason logging (entities not shown)
nodes.rationale: After HA 2026.9.0, 12 Matter covers vanished silently. Discovery was already discarding them correctly, but on a wall tablet the discard was invisible. Observability, not a new filter: every discard point logs why, shown in a closed-by-default Diagnostica section grouped by reason and sorted by actionability.

nodes.label: Matter duplicate-device detection by serial number
nodes.rationale: HA 2026.9.0 re-registers Matter devices; working entities migrate to an area-less copy. Copies are paired by serial number, not name, because the name is exactly what diverges.
nodes.norm_label: matter duplicate-device detection by serial number

nodes.label: Home section order (Alarm/Energy/Surveillance)
nodes.rationale: One linear order shared by desktop and mobile so the two never disagree; up/down arrows instead of drag-and-drop to avoid colliding with long-press-to-hide; unmentioned future sections fused next to default neighbours rather than appended.

nodes.label: House consumption, derived automatically
nodes.rationale: Removes the last manual setup step (a template sensor). consumption = production + gridImport - gridExport + batteryDischarge - batteryCharge; explicit sensor always wins; any input missing shows '—' rather than a partial sum; derived values are labelled 'calculated'.

nodes.label: Battery sign self-diagnosis with one-tap invert
nodes.rationale: No universal sign convention for a single signed battery sensor; default positive = charging. A rolling window flags the derived value coming out negative more often than not and Settings -> Energy offers a one-tap invert, never showing a negative consumption meanwhile.
nodes.norm_label: battery sign self-diagnosis with one-tap invert

nodes.label: Self-explanatory empty states (three cases)
nodes.rationale: (a) Empty rooms discovery shows 'Go to Areas' regardless of cause; (b) a configured energy role pointing at a missing entity names the ID and links to the Settings row; (c) a module hidden on purpose stays silently hidden.

nodes.label: Forceable demo data scenarios (?demo&scenario=…)
nodes.rationale: Each scenario is a pure data patch to SEED/DEMO_CONFIG applied before connect, with no branching elsewhere, so a scenario runs exactly the code a real install runs. Later extended with call-timeout (v1.8.1) and alarm-pin (v1.9.0).

nodes.label: Single-ring energy fallback
nodes.rationale: Used when no export sensor exists; its headline mixed an instantaneous ratio into a daily card (same class as the v1.5.4 gridNote bug), now uses the daily self-consumption percentage or '—'.

nodes.label: Three-layer camera live view strategy (camera/stream HLS)
nodes.rationale: The old live URL substituted camera_proxy -> camera_proxy_stream, which only serves MJPEG and is absent on RTSP/ONVIF/generic cameras (most installs), and its token expired. Replaced with layered HLS / hls.js / fast still polling, first that works wins; stills labelled 'preview refreshing' so they never pretend to be live.
nodes.norm_label: three-layer camera live view strategy (camera/stream hls)

nodes.label: Smart plug three-level state (off / active / running)
nodes.rationale: Relay state answers 'is it energized', not 'is the appliance working'; a device_class power sensor on the same device with a 3 W default threshold distinguishes idle from running.
nodes.norm_label: smart plug three-level state (off / active / running)

nodes.label: Alarm panel auto-discovery
nodes.rationale: Alarm was the only module with no auto-discovery; first alarm_control_panel.* now appears with zero config, buttons follow supported_features.

nodes.label: Alarm PIN awareness (gated no-op with explanatory note)
nodes.rationale: Arming a code_format panel without a code fails; rather than call blindly and fail silently, the action became a no-op with a note. A full keypad was follow-up work (delivered in v1.9.0).
nodes.norm_label: alarm pin awareness (gated no-op with explanatory note)

nodes.label: Daily-totals consistency in energy notes (gridNote, periodNote)
nodes.rationale: gridNote mixed an instantaneous export reading into a daily sentence; units baked into translated templates moved into the formatted value so translators cannot duplicate or drop a unit.
nodes.norm_label: daily-totals consistency in energy notes (gridnote, periodnote)

nodes.label: powerVal() unit-normalizing helper
nodes.rationale: W sensors were treated as kW (1000x too small). powerVal() reads the real unit_of_measurement and normalizes to watts; an unrecognized unit is shown as-is because an honest number in a strange unit beats a wrong one.

nodes.label: Instantaneous power unit setting (Auto / W / kW)
nodes.rationale: Decimals follow the unit rather than being a separate control; daily kWh totals deliberately untouched since they are energy, not power.
nodes.norm_label: instantaneous power unit setting (auto / w / kw)

nodes.label: Settings panel tabs (Stanze · Energia · Telecamere · Diagnostica)
nodes.rationale: Five flat scrolling sections became four tabs, never abbreviated, 44 px targets. Since the panel is where people go when something is broken, a dot marks tabs with a verified issue and opening jumps straight there, overriding the remembered tab.
nodes.norm_label: settings panel tabs (stanze · energia · telecamere · diagnostica)

nodes.label: Cover slider long-press / NaN position fix
nodes.rationale: A slow touch drag is a long-press: the hide-entity timer fired mid-drag, unmounted the row and sent position NaN. Timer now cancelled on 10 px move and pointercancel; cover row drops long-press-to-hide; NaN and unchanged values are not sent; slider only with SET_POSITION.
nodes.norm_label: cover slider long-press / nan position fix

nodes.label: Diagnostics panel (Settings -> Diagnostica)
nodes.rationale: A Shelly EM support case took six messages because every clue only reached console.info, while the real audience (companion app, wall tablet) has no console. Surfaces config path, per-role energy resolution and verdicts, daily-total sources, lifetime-counter mistakes and environment; renders even when discovery or config failed.

nodes.label: Copy diagnostics button
nodes.rationale: Turns a bug report into a paste; selectable-text fallback where the iframe denies clipboard access; entity IDs never truncated.

nodes.label: Settings panel (gear icon)
nodes.rationale: Two independent reports asked to hide/unhide rooms and entities without editing config.js over SSH. The panel only decides visibility and order as a layer on top; config.js keeps sole say over which entity plays a role. Free layout composition is deliberately left to Lovelace.

nodes.label: Per-user settings persistence via frontend/set_user_data
nodes.rationale: Follows the user from wall tablet to phone; localStorage fallback surfaced in the panel header instead of failing silently.

nodes.label: Adaptive Casa surveillance card (1-4 tiles, +N more, motion-first)
nodes.rationale: The card rendered only camList[0]; up to 4 parallel snapshot requests is below what the Sorveglianza tab already issues.
nodes.norm_label: adaptive casa surveillance card (1-4 tiles, +n more, motion-first)

nodes.label: Room tiles sized to content (min-content rows)
nodes.rationale: Rooms stretched to fill leftover height; rooms.max default raised from 8 to 12.
nodes.norm_label: room tiles sized to content (min-content rows)

nodes.label: Extended room domains, binary_sensor and sensor pills
nodes.rationale: Adds humidifier, lock, water_heater, valve, lawn_mower, siren with their own active semantics; pills only when news (open door, low battery).
nodes.norm_label: extended room domains, binary_sensor and sensor pills

nodes.label: Zero-config Energy tab and no-data chart message
nodes.norm_label: zero-config energy tab and no-data chart message

nodes.label: Root padding matching neumorphic shadow reach
nodes.norm_label: root padding matching neumorphic shadow reach

nodes.label: Compact Fotovoltaico card value tiles
nodes.rationale: With cameras present the compact card dropped the three values from the markup entirely.

nodes.label: Energy role color grammar (sage = solar, terracotta = grid)
nodes.rationale: The Energy chart had production and import colors inverted versus the ring; fixed together with the fed-to-grid bar so the two views agree.
nodes.norm_label: energy role color grammar (sage = solar, terracotta = grid)

nodes.label: Fed-to-grid third bar in the trend chart
nodes.rationale: No sensor means no bar, not a bar stuck at zero.
nodes.norm_label: fed-to-grid third bar in the trend chart

nodes.label: Removal of appliance remaining-time text
nodes.rationale: Integrations report remaining time inconsistently (one showed '2026 min remaining'); rather than per-integration guessing, the field was dropped.

nodes.label: Flat grid source schema in HA energy prefs
nodes.rationale: Some installs put stat_energy_from directly on the grid source instead of under flow_from/flow_to; both shapes are read, deduplicated, and unknown shapes log the field names found.
nodes.norm_label: flat grid source schema in ha energy prefs

nodes.label: Deferred src/href/points binding after mount
nodes.rationale: The browser's HTML parser fetches / before any JS runs, requesting literal '{{ m.icon }}' URLs (15+ 404s per load); these are now set once real data exists.

nodes.label: First render resolves unresolved holes silently
nodes.norm_label: first render resolves unresolved holes silently

nodes.label: Summing every energy_prefs entry per role
nodes.rationale: Mapping kept only the first array/meter per role and dropped the rest; installs with a second array or contract need the sum.
nodes.norm_label: summing every energy_prefs entry per role

nodes.label: Butt linecap for near-zero ring segments
nodes.rationale: stroke-linecap round paints a dot even for a zero-length dash.
nodes.norm_label: butt linecap for near-zero ring segments

nodes.label: Double concentric energy ring
nodes.rationale: The old ring compared production against grid import, two numbers that never summed to anything. Outer = house consumption (self-consumption + import), inner = production (self-consumption + export); the shared self-consumption segment has the same color and start in both. Different math, not a restyle.

nodes.label: Energy mapping from HA Energy dashboard (energy/get_prefs)
nodes.rationale: Energy setup becomes optional; falls back to device_class energy heuristics; explicit config.js always wins.
nodes.norm_label: energy mapping from ha energy dashboard (energy/get_prefs)

nodes.label: panel_custom name: self-check
nodes.rationale: The most common HACS/manual mistake (name: not matching the folder) produced a blank panel with nothing in the console; now a console.error plus an on-page message naming expected and actual.

nodes.label: Example config renamed live_dashboard_config.example.js
nodes.rationale: Sharing a name with the file users must create was a trap: editing it in place worked until the next update overwrote it.

nodes.label: Config at config/www/live_dashboard_config.js, outside the HACS folder
nodes.rationale: A HACS update overwrites the plugin folder, so a config placed there is wiped; config/www/ itself is never touched by HACS.
nodes.norm_label: config at config/www/live_dashboard_config.js, outside the hacs folder

nodes.label: Weather station sensors preferred over weather entity
nodes.norm_label: weather station sensors preferred over weather entity

nodes.label: Exclusion of config-referenced entities from generic room lists
nodes.rationale: One schema-agnostic exclusion instead of a hardcoded field list to keep in sync as modules grow.
nodes.norm_label: exclusion of config-referenced entities from generic room lists

nodes.label: ASSET_VERSION cache-bust propagated to every loadScript()
nodes.rationale: ?v= only covered the page; scripts it loaded stayed stale after deploy and restart with no visible sign. One bump now busts the whole chain.
nodes.norm_label: asset_version cache-bust propagated to every loadscript()

nodes.label: Appliances module (config.appliances)
nodes.rationale: No HA domain standardizes appliance running state, so it is explicit config.

nodes.label: [data-sel="true"] !important selected-state fix
nodes.rationale: Inline style background/box-shadow/color always beat the stylesheet rule regardless of specificity, so selected state was literally invisible on mobile mode buttons.

nodes.label: Zero-areas empty state with link to Settings -> Areas
nodes.rationale: The single most likely reason a fresh install looks broken on first load.
nodes.norm_label: zero-areas empty state with link to settings -> areas

nodes.label: Grid figure tooltip on the Fotovoltaico card
nodes.norm_label: grid figure tooltip on the fotovoltaico card

nodes.label: Irrigation buttons mode (input_button per duration)
nodes.rationale: A real install's zones were opened by a script owning the timing with no switch to drive; valve alone could not represent it.

nodes.label: Panel custom element tag derived from deploy folder (<folder>-panel)
nodes.rationale: A hardcoded casa-panel tag gave a blank panel for any other name: and collided for side-by-side installs.
nodes.norm_label: panel custom element tag derived from deploy folder (<folder>-panel)

nodes.label: No internet access needed to run
nodes.rationale: React, fonts and hls.js ship in public/vendor/ so a local-only Home Assistant draws the dashboard as designed.
nodes.norm_label: no internet access needed to run

nodes.label: Manual installation
nodes.rationale: The casa/casa2 side-by-side pattern is manual-only; carrying it to HACS is the most common cause of a name: mismatch.

nodes.label: module_url ?v= cache-busting
nodes.rationale: /local/ is served with long cache headers and ES modules are cached aggressively, so a hard refresh does not reliably refetch panel.js.

nodes.label: Settings panel layered over config.js
nodes.rationale: config.js resolves roles; the panel only decides visibility, with a 'differs from config.js' pill.

nodes.label: Enabling Energy (role-based sensor mapping)
nodes.rationale: Sensors are asked for by role, not brand, so any integration works.

nodes.label: Enabling Irrigation (valve vs buttons)
nodes.rationale: Agronomic math (ET0/ETc, deficit) is deliberately out of scope: it depends on the user's own station and soil data.

nodes.label: Vehicle (optional)
nodes.rationale: No HA domain standardizes car telemetry, so mapping is explicit field by field.

nodes.label: Smart plugs without a config.appliances entry
nodes.norm_label: smart plugs without a config.appliances entry

nodes.label: README camera live layer order (hls.js 1.7.4, native HLS, fast stills)
nodes.rationale: Updated in v1.9.0: hls.js first (Chrome, Firefox, Android, desktop Safari, iOS 17.1+), native HLS only where hls.js cannot run (iOS before 17.1), fast still polling last when no stream support; Diagnostics shows the active layer and what it fell back from.
nodes.norm_label: readme camera live layer order (hls.js 1.7.4, native hls, fast stills)

nodes.label: Known limits
nodes.rationale: The result is only as good as Home Assistant area assignments; the dashboard is not a Lovelace replacement.

nodes.label: Vendored React 18.3.1 UMD scripts (./vendor/react-*.js)
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: loaded before support.js so loadReactUmd() skips the CDN fetch; dashboard starts without internet. Byte-identical to the SRI-pinned unpkg files; a missing vendor file falls back to CDN.

nodes.label: window.CASA_REACT_SOURCE (local|cdn)
nodes.rationale: Records which React runtime actually ran, surfaced in Diagnostica (diagEnvironment.reactSource) because wall-tablet users have no console.

nodes.label: @font-face Caprasimo/Figtree from ./vendor/fonts/
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: fonts shipped locally (OFL) instead of Google Fonts so the page looks the same offline; Figtree variable, one file per subset.

nodes.label: loadUserConfig()
nodes.rationale: window.CASA_CONFIG global instead of import(): import() is blocked under file:// (demo mode). Records attempts for Diagnostica.

nodes.label: _boot()
nodes.rationale: Assigns discovery/be/cfg/registries/t/strings synchronously together so a hass-states push mid-boot can't render a half-initialised component.

nodes.label: _closeCam()
nodes.rationale: Stops fast poll, destroys hls.js, bumps camStreamReqId to invalidate in-flight stream requests, clears the stable video ref key.

nodes.label: _camStartStream()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0 layer order: hls.js first when MediaSource/ManagedMediaSource exists, then native HLS via _camCanNative, then snapshot. Old order trusted canPlayType(); Chrome answers 'maybe' but can't parse HA's fMP4/HEVC (Imou DEMUXER_ERROR_COULD_NOT_PARSE).

nodes.label: _camVideoRef(layer, url)
nodes.rationale: Stable ref per layer|url: a fresh arrow each render re-set src/re-attached hls.js (14 reloads in 10 s). Forces muted (React doesn't reflect template muted). Sets data-layer/data-url; 'playing' listener sets camPlayingUrl, 'error' listener (native layer only) calls _camLayerFailed.

nodes.label: _camLayerFailed(layer, detail)
nodes.rationale: Steps down hls.js -> native HLS -> snapshot instead of a black box; records failedLayer/failDetail in camDiag so Diagnostica explains the fallback.

nodes.label: _ensureHlsJs()
nodes.rationale: Lazily loads vendored ./vendor/hls.light.min.js once per session; resolves false only when vendor/ is missing.

nodes.label: _attachHlsJs(video, url)
nodes.rationale: Fatal Hls.Events.ERROR handler calls _camLayerFailed('hlsjs').

nodes.label: _camStartFastPoll()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0 load-chained: preloads each still with new Image() and sets state.camStillSrc on load, next request only after the previous arrived. A fixed 400 ms timer never let a slow camera (8.5 s/still) finish a frame.

nodes.label: _camStopFastPoll()
nodes.rationale: Bumps _camStillGen so pending preload callbacks are discarded.

nodes.label: _bindAttr(name, value)
nodes.rationale: Sets src/href/points from a ref callback after mount (browser parser acts on them before JS). v1.9.0 idempotent: re-setting the same src restarted /

nodes.label: Camera badge (Connecting… vs Live vs snapshot)
nodes.rationale: 'Live' only once frames actually play (camPlayingUrl === camStreamUrl); HA can take 15 s+ to start a stream, and a black box labelled Live reads as broken.
nodes.norm_label: camera badge (connecting... vs live vs snapshot)

nodes.label: Diagnostica camera rows (layer · ws · fell back from)
nodes.rationale: Visible counterpart of camera layer selection and fallback for users without a console.
nodes.norm_label: diagnostica camera rows (layer · ws · fell back from)

nodes.label: alarmGuardedCall()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: a code_format-gated arm/disarm opens the PIN pad instead of a no-op; disarm gated on code_format alone, arm softened by code_arm_required.

nodes.label: state.pin (PIN pad state)
nodes.rationale: Code lives only in state.pin while the pad is open: never stored, logged (call() logs entity/service, not data) or shown in clear.

nodes.label: pinSubmit()
nodes.rationale: Pad stays open until HA answers; a wrong code clears the digits and shows pinRejected.

nodes.label: Alarm PIN pad template
nodes.rationale: Numeric keypad for code_format 'number', password field otherwise. pinNumeric and pinIsText are separate names (CLAUDE.md rule 6). No mount animation to avoid replay on re-render.

nodes.label: call(domain, service, data)
nodes.rationale: v1.8.1 single point for every service call: logs to _actionLog ring buffer (Recent actions), always resolves, surfaces failures via toast.

nodes.label: SAVE_PREFS(prefs)
nodes.rationale: Persists immediately on every toggle, fire-and-forget.

nodes.label: _resolveEnergyDaily()
nodes.rationale: Fills today's production/import/export not set in config.js: HA Energy prefs first, then heuristic auto-discovery; sums multiple ids; captures diag data for Diagnostica.

nodes.label: _loadHourlyEnergy()
nodes.rationale: Ring strip (v1.8.0): refetched only when the wall clock crosses an hour; undefined = not yet resolved vs null = no statistics.

nodes.label: _sampleBatterySign()
nodes.rationale: Throttled buffer: a negative derived consumption is never shown; sustained negatives flag an inverted battery sign convention.

nodes.label: runValve(id, minutes)
nodes.rationale: Two switch calls plus a persisted deadline so the close isn't only a setTimeout living in one tab.

nodes.label: _checkIrrigationEnds()
nodes.rationale: Every 15 s and at boot, closes any valve whose deadline passed from whichever client is open; _irrigationClosing guards against double turn_off.

nodes.label: Irrigation zones model (isRunning from valve, makeDurationButton)
nodes.rationale: v1.8.1: running state from the valve entity itself, not the last tapped button; irrPending guards double taps until call() resolves.
nodes.norm_label: irrigation zones model (isrunning from valve, makedurationbutton)

nodes.label: Layered camera live-view fallback (hls.js -> native HLS -> stills)
nodes.norm_label: layered camera live-view fallback (hls.js -> native hls -> stills)

nodes.label: dash_neumo_mobile.html (phone layout)
nodes.rationale: Phone layout of the dashboard: sc-if/sc-for HTML template plus an inline text/x-dc Component class; most methods are kept identical to dash_neumo.html so desktop and mobile never disagree.

nodes.label: Vendored React 18.3.1 UMD script tags
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: React ships with the dashboard instead of unpkg; plain tags before support.js so loadReactUmd() skips its CDN fetch when window.React/ReactDOM exist. Versioned file names instead of ?v= since content never changes.

nodes.label: window.CASA_REACT_SOURCE
nodes.rationale: Records whether React came from local vendor/ or fell back to the CDN (half-copied manual install); surfaced in Diagnostica -> Ambiente.

nodes.label: @font-face rules (Caprasimo, Figtree) from ./vendor/fonts/
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: fonts ship locally (OFL) instead of Google Fonts so the page looks the same with no internet; Figtree variable, one file per subset.

nodes.label: ASSET_V (cache-bust version from ?v=)
nodes.rationale: Reuses panel.js's ?v= so one VERSION bump busts the whole script chain, not just this file.

nodes.label: loadScript()
nodes.rationale: Classic <script> injection instead of import(): Chrome blocks module fetches under file://, which would break demo mode. A 404 resolves false, not an error.

nodes.label: CONFIG_PATHS
nodes.rationale: /local/live_dashboard_config.js first (outside HACS-managed folder so updates don't wipe it); /local/ candidates only tried inside the HA iframe to avoid pointless 404s.

nodes.label: loadUserConfig()
nodes.rationale: Reads window.CASA_CONFIG global (not a module) and records per-path attempts for Diagnostica.

nodes.label: state.pin (alarm PIN pad state)
nodes.rationale: The code lives only in this.state.pin while the pad is open: never stored, never logged, never shown in clear.

nodes.label: _closeCam()
nodes.rationale: Tears down timers, fast poll, hls.js instance, bumps camStreamReqId and clears the stable video ref key so a reopened camera starts clean.

nodes.label: _camStartStream()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0 layer order: hls.js first wherever MediaSource/ManagedMediaSource exists, then native HLS via _camCanNative, then snapshot. Chrome answers 'maybe' for HLS but can't parse HA's fMP4/HEVC (DEMUXER_ERROR_COULD_NOT_PARSE on a real Imou), hls.js plays it fine.

nodes.label: _camVideoRef()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: one stable ref per layer|url. A fresh arrow each render made React re-run the ref, resetting src/re-attaching hls.js: 14 reloads in 10 s, playback never past 0.45 s. Also mutes for real, since React doesn't reliably reflect the muted attribute.

nodes.label: _camLayerFailed()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: a chosen layer that fails while playing steps down (hls.js -> native HLS -> fast stills) instead of a black box, recording failedLayer/failDetail in camDiag for Diagnostica.

nodes.label: _ensureHlsJs()
nodes.rationale: Lazy-loads ./vendor/hls.light.min.js once, memoized in _hlsJsLoadPromise.

nodes.label: _camStartFastPoll()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: load-chained instead of a fixed 400 ms timer; the next still is requested only after the previous arrived, preloaded with new Image() so the shown frame is swapped, never blanked (one still = 8.5 s on a real ONVIF camera).

nodes.label: _camStopFastPoll()
nodes.rationale: Bumps _camStillGen so in-flight preloads from an older poll are ignored.

nodes.label: _resolveEnergyDaily()
nodes.rationale: Resolves daily production/grid import/export from config, then HA energy prefs, then auto-discovery; lists raw source keys when a type is present but unrecognized so unknown schemas self-diagnose.

nodes.label: powerVal()
nodes.rationale: Normalizes W/kW/MW sensors to the powerUnit pref; an unrecognized unit is shown as-is, since an honest number in a strange unit beats a wrong one.

nodes.label: _sampleBatterySign()
nodes.rationale: Samples (at most every 10 s, 3-min window) whether derived consumption goes negative, the symptom of an inverted battery power sign.

nodes.label: call()
nodes.rationale: v1.8.1: every service call is logged in _actionLog (entity and service, never data) with outcome/timing, and failures raise a visible toast: no silent failures.

nodes.label: _checkIrrigationEnds()
nodes.rationale: Closes valves whose persisted end time passed; _irrigationClosing guards against double turn_off when two 15 s ticks land close together.

nodes.label: _bindAttr()
nodes.rationale: Ref-callback setter for src/href/points (cannot be holes). v1.9.0 idempotent: re-setting the same src still restarts an img/video load, which aborted every slow snapshot.

nodes.label: SETTINGS_* handlers (room/entity/camera/module/section/power unit/plug threshold/battery sign/reset)
nodes.rationale: Kept identical to dash_neumo.html so desktop and mobile can never disagree about what's hidden.

nodes.label: alarmGuardedCall()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: a code-gated alarm action opens the PIN pad instead of doing nothing; ungated actions call alarm_control_panel directly.

nodes.label: pinSubmit()
nodes.rationale: Pad stays open until HA answers: a wrong code clears the digits and shows the error next to where it was typed, on top of call()'s toast.

nodes.label: pinKeys
nodes.rationale: Keypad only for code_format 'number'; other formats get a password field with the system keyboard.

nodes.label: Alarm PIN pad template
nodes.rationale: No mount animation: with live state pushes a style= animation would replay on every re-render while the pad is open.
